title: Walthamstow Emergency Help Points
summary: Hospital routes, Lea Valley flood hazards, and essential supply centers across Walthamstow (E17).
content: For immediate life-threatening emergencies, always dial 999 or 112 first. 1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals: Whipps Cross Hospital, Whipps Cross Road, Leytonstone E11 1NR. Travel guidance: from Walthamstow Central station, ~30 min walk south-east along Hoe Street and Whipps Cross Road, or take bus 20, 257, or W12 directly to hospital grounds. For major trauma emergencies, The Royal London Hospital (Major Trauma Centre), Whitechapel Road, Whitechapel E1 1FR. Travel guidance: from Walthamstow Central, take Victoria line south or London Overground rail to Liverpool Street / Whitechapel. 2. Urgent Treatment Centres: Whipps Cross Urgent Treatment Centre, Hospital Grounds, Whipps Cross Road E11 1NR (open 24 hours, co-located with main emergency department). 3. Area Hazards: River Lea flood basin, Walthamstow Reservoirs (Lea Valley Wetlands), and Dagenham Brook. Low-lying terrain along Blackhorse Lane, St James Street, and Coppermill Lane is prone to surface runoff and river surges. 4. Essential Supplies: Pharmacies and retail supermarkets along Walthamstow High Street, Hoe Street, and Selborne Road provide drinking water, emergency rations, and medicine stock during major disruptions. Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
